endpoint.description: Generates OAuth 2.0 access token using client credentials and API secret.

headerParameters.name: Authorization
headerParameters.description: Bearer token header with API secret

codeSamples.php:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, [
  CURLOPT_URL => "https://uat.digitalrakshak.io/v1/oauth/token",
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => "POST",
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => http_build_query([
  "grant_type" => "client_credentials"
]),
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => [
    "Authorization: Bearer <API_SECRET>",
    "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
  ],
]);

$response = curl_exec($curl);
curl_close($curl);

echo $response;
codeSamples.go:
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"net/http"
	"io/ioutil"
)

func main() {
	url := "https://uat.digitalrakshak.io/v1/oauth/token"
	payload := strings.NewReader(`grant_type=client_credentials`)

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, payload)
	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer <API_SECRET>")
	req.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")

	res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()

	body, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(res.Body)
	fmt.Println(string(body))
}
codeSamples.ruby:
require "uri"
require "net/http"

url = URI("https://uat.digitalrakshak.io/v1/oauth/token")

http.use_ssl = true

request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(url)
request["Authorization"] = 'Bearer <API_SECRET>'
request["Content-Type"] = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
request.body = URI.encode_www_form({
  "grant_type": "client_credentials"
})

response = http.request(request)
puts response.read_body

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"net/http"
	"io/ioutil"
)

func main() {
	url := "https://uat.digitalrakshak.io/api/v1/protean/bankaccountverifications"
	payload := strings.NewReader(`{
  "beneficiaryAccount": "000000000000000",
  "beneficiaryIFSC": "ABCD0000000",
  "beneficiaryMobile": "XXXXXXXXXX",
  "beneficiaryName": "xxxxxxxxxx",
  "nameFuzzy": "true",
  "nameMatchScore": "0.9"
}`)

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, payload)
	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer <access_token>")
	req.Header.Add("apikey", "<API_KEY>")
	req.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/json")

	res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()

	body, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(res.Body)
	fmt.Println(string(body))
}
